post.title: Government Exams After 12th: Complete List and Preparation Roadmap
post.description: Complete list of government exams you can appear for after 12th pass. Covers SSC CHSL, Railway Group D, NDA, Defence, Police, and more with eligibility details.
post.author: GovtExamPath Team
post.body:
## Exciting Career Options Right After 12th

Completing 12th class opens the door to several prestigious government exams. You don't need to wait for graduation to start your government career. Many exams specifically recruit 12th pass candidates, offering competitive salaries and long-term job security.

## Top Government Exams After 12th

### 1. NDA (National Defence Academy)

**The most prestigious exam after 12th** — trains you to become an officer in the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force.

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Conducted by | UPSC |
| Eligibility | 12th pass (or appearing), male candidates, age 16.5-19.5 |
| Female candidates | Eligible (since 2025) |
| Exam pattern | Written test (900 marks) + SSB Interview (900 marks) |
| Training | 3 years at NDA Khadakwasla, Pune |
| Starting salary | Rs 56,100 (Level 10) after training + Military Service Pay |

**Why choose NDA:** Free world-class education (equivalent to graduation), guaranteed officer rank, adventure-filled career, starting in-hand salary of Rs 90,000+ after training.

### 2. SSC CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level)

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Conducted by | Staff Selection Commission |
| Eligibility | 12th pass from recognized board |
| Age | 18-27 years (General) |
| Posts | LDC, JSA, Postal Assistant, DEO |
| Salary range | Rs 19,900-25,500 basic (Level 2-4) |

**In-hand salary:** Rs 33,000-45,000/month depending on post and city.

### 3. Railway Group D

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Conducted by | Railway Recruitment Boards |
| Eligibility | 10th pass + ITI or 12th pass |
| Age | 18-33 years |
| Posts | Track Maintainer, Helper, Porter |
| Salary | Rs 18,000 basic (Level 1) |
| Vacancies | 60,000-1,00,000 per recruitment cycle |

**In-hand salary:** Rs 33,000-37,000/month with railway perks including free travel passes.

### 4. Indian Army Soldier (Various Entries)

| Entry | Eligibility | Age |
|-------|-------------|-----|
| Soldier GD (General Duty) | 10th/12th pass | 17.5-23 |
| Soldier Technical | 12th with Physics, Chemistry, Math | 17.5-23 |
| Soldier Clerk/SKT | 12th with 60% aggregate | 17.5-23 |
| Soldier Nursing | 12th with Biology | 17.5-23 |

**Selection:** Physical Test + Written Exam + Medical
**Salary:** Rs 21,700 basic (Level 3) + Military Service Pay + allowances = Rs 35,000-45,000 in-hand.

### 5. Indian Navy Sailors and Airmen (Air Force)

**Navy Sailors (SSR/AA):**
- Eligibility: 12th with Physics and Math (60%+)
- Selection: Written + Physical + Medical
- Starting salary: Rs 21,700 + allowances

**Air Force Airmen (Group X & Y):**
- Eligibility: 12th with Physics and Math (Group X) or 12th pass (Group Y)
- Selection: Written + Physical + Medical + Adaptability Test
- Starting salary: Rs 21,700-25,500 + allowances

### 6. SSC MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff)

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Eligibility | 10th pass (even simpler than CHSL) |
| Age | 18-25 years |
| Posts | Peon, Daftary, Jamadar, Junior Gestetner Operator |
| Salary | Rs 18,000 basic (Level 1) |

**Best for:** Those who want quick government entry and plan to prepare for higher exams while working.

### 7. SSC GD Constable

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Eligibility | 10th/12th pass |
| Age | 18-23 years (General) |
| Posts | Constable in BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, AR, NIA, SSF |
| Salary | Rs 21,700 basic (Level 3) |

**In-hand salary:** Rs 35,000-40,000/month. Includes uniform, housing, and force-specific allowances.

### 8. State Police Constable

Each state conducts its own police recruitment. General requirements:
- Education: 10th or 12th pass
- Physical standards vary by state
- Age: 18-25 years (varies)
- Salary: Rs 21,700-25,500 basic

### 9. India Post GDS (Gramin Dak Sevak)

| Detail | Information |
|--------|------------|
| Eligibility | 10th pass from recognized board |
| Age | 18-40 years |
| Posts | Branch Postmaster, Dak Sevak |
| Salary | Rs 12,000-14,500/month (TRCA based) |
| Selection | Based on 10th class marks (no written exam!) |
| Vacancies | 30,000-40,000 per cycle |

**Unique feature:** No written exam — selection is purely merit-based on 10th marks. Easiest government entry.

### 10. RRB NTPC (Lower Posts)

Junior Clerk and Commercial cum Ticket Clerk posts under RRB NTPC require only 12th pass:
- Salary: Rs 21,700 basic (Level 3)
- In-hand: Rs 38,000-42,000/month

## Preparation Roadmap: First 6 Months After 12th

### Month 1-2: Explore and Decide
- Use GovtExamPath's Eligibility Checker to see all exams you qualify for
- Research the posts, salaries, and job profiles for each exam
- Choose 2-3 target exams (one primary + one backup)
- Gather study materials

### Month 3-4: Foundation Building
- Start with your weakest subject
- Complete basic concepts in Math, Reasoning, and English
- Begin GK/GS preparation with Lucent's GK
- Read newspaper daily for current affairs
- 4-5 hours daily study

### Month 5-6: Practice Phase
- Solve previous year papers for your target exam
- Take mock tests weekly
- Focus on speed and accuracy
- Apply for upcoming notifications

## Which Exam Should You Target First?

**If you're interested in Defence:** NDA (apply immediately after 12th — age window is narrow)

**If you want a desk job:** SSC CHSL (most popular choice after 12th)

**If you're okay with physical work:** Railway Group D or SSC GD Constable (massive vacancies)

**If you want the easiest entry:** India Post GDS (no written exam, 10th marks based)

**Smart strategy:** Apply for multiple exams simultaneously. The syllabus for SSC CHSL, Railway Group D, and SSC GD overlaps significantly (Math, Reasoning, GK, English). Preparing for one prepares you for all.

## Don't Stop Here

While appearing for these exams, continue your graduation (you can do BA/BSc/BCom through distance/open university). Once you have a degree, a whole new set of exams opens up — SSC CGL, IBPS PO, SBI PO, UPSC CSE, and many more. Think of 12th-level exams as your stepping stone, not your final destination.
